title: Superleads Mail Send Config (non-secret only)
description: Configuration for scripts/send_mail.py. Credentials are supplied ONLY via SUPERLEADS_SMTP_USER / SUPERLEADS_SMTP_PASSWORD environment variables and MUST NOT appear in this file or any graph/schema record.

smtp_host.description: SMTP host. Defaults to the provider preset when omitted.

smtp_port.description: SMTP port. Defaults to 465 for ssl and 587 for starttls.

from_addr.description: From address. Falls back to SUPERLEADS_SMTP_USER, then must be provided.

to.description: Primary recipients, capped at 20 total across to/cc/bcc.

body.description: Plain text or HTML body. Prefer body_file for longer scheduled reports.

body_file.description: UTF-8 file path to read the body from (overrides body).

html.description: Treat body as HTML when true; default false.
